title: Choose k Before Revealing the Test Set
description: Course activity for Exercise 4: tune KNN's k using training and validation data only, then lock a final choice and reveal the held-out test result once.
instructions: Compare the training-selected and validation-selected values of k below. Choose a final k using only the training and validation lines, then press "Lock Choice and Reveal Test Result" to see the test score.
reflectionPrompts: Which value of k performed best on the training set? Which performed best on the validation set?
Why might the value with the lowest training error fail on new participants?
Should you change k after seeing the test result?
